verdict.rationale: Hands-on reports show Elicit attaches citations and links to papers for generated concepts (elicit-comm-1) and supplies direct quotes alongside its statements (elicit-comm-4). That same user found the quotes sometimes contradict the claim, which limits trust, though it still lets a researcher check against the source. The pack has no first-party documentation of claim-level citations, so this rests on community anecdote only. Missing for 10: first-party docs describing per-claim citations or sentence-level source linking, evidence that every substantive claim (including research reports and chat answers) is cited, and corroboration that citations reliably support the claims.
